sentences.text: No, the directions do not permit a UCB to levy pre-payment charges on a floating rate loan to an individual for purposes other than business that was sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026.

The applicable direction for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 says that for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
A general provision that pre-payment charges may be as per a UCB’s approved policy applies only in cases other than those covered by the no-charge directions.
